title: BRITE-338733: From RecA inhibition to cancer treatment.
authors: Furqan, Tiyyaba; Bekdash, Amira; Chalissery, Jisha; Al-Marzouqi, Ahmed H; Arabi, Alya A
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD筛选RSC染色质重塑复合物ATPase抑制剂，并验证其与DNA结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作和物理模拟方法，但核心是抑制剂发现而非TF-DNA结合机制，故为中档匹配。
abstract: ATP-dependent chromatin remodelers play an important role in regulating cellular processes by modulating the chromatin structure. Despite their significance, the ATPase domains within the catalytic subunit of these remodelers remain not extensively explored as a therapeutic target. The aim of this study is to identify computationally and validate experimentally novel inhibitors of the ATP hydrolysis activity in the RSC chromatin remodeler, by binding to its ATP binding pocket and/or to DNA. Following an initial screening through docking studies, a list of five compounds were selected for a detailed analysis. Based on molecular dynamics simulations, BRITE-338733 was highlighted as the most promising candidate. This result was supported experimentally with ATP hydrolysis assays, where the BRITE-338733 stood as the compound that demonstrated significant inhibition. Furthermore, both computational and experimental analyses showed that BRITE-338733 binds strongly to DNA. Additionally, BRITE-338733 demonstrated cytotoxicity against breast cancer cells, suggesting its potential as an anticancer therapeutic.
abstract_zh: ATP依赖性染色质重塑因子通过调节染色质结构在调控细胞过程中发挥重要作用。尽管其重要性显著，但这些重塑因子催化亚基中的ATPase结构域作为治疗靶点尚未被广泛探索。本研究旨在通过计算识别并通过实验验证新型抑制剂，这些抑制剂通过结合RSC染色质重塑因子的ATP结合口袋和/或DNA来抑制其ATP水解活性。经过对接研究的初步筛选，选定了五种化合物进行详细分析。基于分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，BRITE-338733被突出为最有前景的候选化合物。这一结果通过ATP水解实验得到支持，其中BRITE-338733表现出显著抑制作用的化合物。此外，计算和实验分析均表明BRITE-338733与DNA强结合。另外，BRITE-338733对乳腺癌细胞显示出细胞毒性，提示其作为抗癌治疗药物的潜力。
